_comment: One-line description per state, shown as the subtitle on state.html. Everyone edits this same file, so two people touching the same state in one class session is a great excuse to practice resolving a merge conflict. Keep entries to one short line each.
Andhra Pradesh: Temple towns, tech parks, and the Eastern Ghats.
Telangana: Hyderabad's biryani, pearls, and a booming IT skyline.
Maharashtra: From the Sahyadris to the Arabian Sea, home of Bollywood and business.
Delhi: The capital — layers of empires under one skyline.
Punjab: Golden fields, a golden temple, and warm hearts.
Karnataka: Silicon plateaus meeting the Western Ghats.
